item_desc: Open spaces all around the building are kept free of any erection and open to the sky, as proposed in the Provisional NOC.
One entry and one exit to the premises with minimum width of 4.5 m and head-room clearance of 5.0 m are provided.
A diesel generator of required capacity is provided as alternate source of electric supply.
Emergency lighting is provided in corridors, common passages and staircases.
The building is compartmented and openings in separating walls are protected with 2-hour fire-resisting doors.
Smoke venting facilities are provided for safe use of exits, with emergency power supply.
All fire safety systems proposed in the Provisional NOC are installed and in working condition.
Fire lifts, refuge areas and fire detection/alarm systems are provided as required for the building height.
